name: frontend-design-pro — ChatGPT knowledge curation guide
note: A starting point you adjust per use case, not a distributed bundle. There is no slim pack artifact: you unzip the one .skill archive and upload a subset of its files by hand. A Custom GPT accepts at most 20 knowledge files for the lifetime of that GPT, and the pack has 8 core files, 17 skill routers and 86 references — so pick for the work you actually do and swap entries as that work changes. A GPT scoped to landing pages and design systems beats one trying to cover all 17 skills.

registry.why: The registry itself — routing table, anti-slop wall, loading protocol. 1,888 tokens. Never omit this one.

adjusting_this_list: Swap the three example skill routers for the ones matching your requests — check the registry table in SKILL.md for the trigger keywords.
Spend the 9 free slots on the references/*.md your skills actually point at, not on more routers.
core/agent-behavior.md and core/user-intake.md are worth a slot if you want the behavioural preamble and the intake questions to survive retrieval.
More files does not mean more depth: retrieval is chunked semantic search, so extra uploads mostly add chunks competing for the same slots.
not_covered_here: The 20-file cap and per-file size limits are OpenAI's and can move; docs/CHATGPT_SETUP.md links the current source. The gate scripts cannot run inside ChatGPT — a recited constraint ID is a claim, not a verified result.
